successors.name: Teutonic Order
successors.text: the Duchy of Estonia without Narva, handed over in 1345

ledger.x: 15 June 1219: Valdemar II's fleet lands at Lindanise and wins the Battle of Lyndanisse; Reval is founded.
1227: the Brothers of the Sword take the Danish north.
7 June 1238: the Treaty of Stensby returns Harria and Vironia to Denmark.
23 April / 16 May 1343: the St George's Night Uprising and the handover of Reval and Wesenberg.
1345: Narva is handed over and receives Lübeck city rights.
1 November 1346: the sale ends the contest; the Duchy of Estonia is the Order's.
1 November 1346: Estonia sold for 19,000 Cologne marks.

wars.name: Estonian Crusade
wars.outcome: The Danes won at Lindanise in 1219 and 'the whole of northern Estonia' fell to Danish control (undated, after 1220); a 1223 Estonian uprising took every Christian stronghold but Tallinn; in 1227 the Livonian Brothers of the Sword conquered all Danish…

wars.name: St. George's Night Uprising
wars.outcome: The Livonian Master Burchard von Dreileben crushed the rising (Kanavere 11 May, Sõjamäe 14 May 1343) and took Reval and Wesenberg under Order garrison; Harria's last strongholds fell in the winter of 1343 and the Ösel rising ended with a conditional surrender…

certainty.note: County names stand in for Harria, Vironia and Jerwia; the page gives no boundary or area.
